Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's rare.
Do you think someone's riding it?"
Touya: "Of course people ride it."
Yamato: "But it's always stopped whenever I see it.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Just imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahahahaha!
To defend those I love, justice's blade strikes the enemy!
My red blood burns crimson! Such is the way of a man!
A man of justice and truth!
FAIN... JIN... BARION!!
Here I stand! For justice... I can die."
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I was waiting here for you..."
Touya: "...You should let Gabon examine you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I couldn't be healthier!
I'm not weak enough to get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm quite confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent terrifies me."
It's pretty good.
Sounds like enka.
Fain: "Right? The ending especially gives me a thrill
just saying it."
Yamato: "He's intoxicated with himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "I-I see. Well, good luck."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm. You might call it 'the Japanese people's
song of the heart,' I suppose."
Fain: "The heart? So a song that speaks directly to the soul,
is that what you mean?"
Yamato: "W-Well, more or less."
Fain: "Oh! Then that means my speech is just as
splendid!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Hehehehe... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my dearest wish!
And that justice is also to protect the ones dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. The ones dear to you, eh...?"
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and f-for Kasumi... No! My justice isn't
so fickle! Oh, what should I do...?"
Yamato: "...What should we do?"
Touya: "We'd better stay away from him..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've resolved to love only one woman.
But to protect the princess, I have a noble and supreme
duty. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! This is a knight's destiny!
Then I shall forge ahead! To fight fate!
No, wait. Master said that wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I must see one or the other through?!
Oh! How can this be!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Grr, it's all because of those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I would never have known
such suffering...
Ah! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr, damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome the ≪Ze=Ode≫ are!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't let something so trivial
break me! Hm? Then...
To turn their plan against them, my love for the two women
and my loyalty to the princess must all be protected...
all at once! Is that it?
No, but that goes against Master's teachings.
Aaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has his troubles too."
Touya: "Well, his life's pretty full in its own way, right?
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
